introduction.html:
Welcome to Shiva Engineering Consultants

At Shiva Engineering Consultants, we are dedicated to providing consulting services in Asset Care, Energy Management, and Valuation Systems that drive growth, efficiency, and success for businesses of all sizes. Our consultants have more than 30 years of in-depth experience in reputed industries. We deliver customised solutions in Project Management, Maintenance Management, Energy Management, Value Engineering, and Value Analysis at corporate and plant levels to align with each client’s unique needs and objectives.

main.html:
Asset Management

Asset management is a systematic approach to the governance and realisation of value. It requires establishment, implementation, operation, maintenance, and continual improvement. This need has been identified by ISO standards; the latest version is ISO 55000-2024.

To maximise asset sweating, a structured approach from cradle—project conceptualisation—to grave—asset disposal—is required, involving stakeholders from engineering, operations, finance, and more. Every organisation is unique, so the methodology must suit its values, mission, size, and operation.

We can help you identify a suitable compatible Asset Management methodology together with available tools for your business ERP.

Project Management

Thinking of achieving a goal beyond regular work? Cost overruns, time overruns, and missed results often arise from an unorganised approach. Every project brings new problems and risks, so a structured Project Management System is needed to establish, improve, and repeat the processes that suit your organisation.

We will help you establish the Project Management System to suit your organisational requirements.

Energy Management

Energy management optimises energy use for the best possible outcomes and conserves it through production and storage planning. Energy saved is energy produced: energy demand continues to increase costs, so savings are tangible. Energy management also helps achieve ESG and SDG goals, environmental sustainability, and investor confidence.

We are here to join you in the Energy Management journey and help you achieve your goals.

Value Engineering

Value engineering systematically analyses the functions of components and materials to lower the cost of goods, products, and services with tolerable loss of performance or functionality. Value is the ratio of function to cost, so it can be improved by improving function or reducing cost while preserving basic functions.

Technical Advisory

Well planned is half done is a famous saying. Planning plays an important role in every activity. To run a successful business, an entrepreneur needs to systematise operations from selection through establishment and sustainability. Due diligence, value analysis, and linking activity with productivity are major steps in plant layout.

Layout with suitable equipment helps in:

  1. Energy Management
  2. Asset Management
  3. Project Management

Early planning produces tangible and intangible results. We integrate engineering with finance to help you run your business more effectively and strengthen your balance sheet.

Valuation

Valuation is part of compliance and assessment of an organisation’s financial health. Manufacturing units have plants and machinery that must be assessed for productivity, financial health, and legal reporting. We conduct valuation of plants and machinery through approved valuers to help you leverage financial planning.

Energy Audit

To begin energy management, you need a complete picture of the existing energy system. We conduct field audits through certified Energy Auditors and collect, or help collect, workable data. This becomes the foundation of your Energy Management journey and improves systems. For larger industries an audit is mandatory; smaller industries also benefit because energy contributes almost one-eighth of manufacturing cost.

spm.html:
Special Purpose Machines

Need customised machines to suit your process, increase accuracy and efficiency, and reduce dependency on human error? We provide low-cost automation of existing machines for particular processes.

Identifying the problem is half the job done. We build Special Purpose Machines (SPM) for specific solutions and can help you identify, customise, and optimise the process.

airPollution.html:
Air Pollution Control Devices

Industrialisation has side effects, and air pollution is one of them. To comply with legal requirements and keep the environment safe and healthy, pollution-control devices are needed. The solution depends on pollutant type and quantity. Air handling is costly, so operating optimisation is important alongside pollution control.

structure.html:
Industrial Structure

Industrial installations need tailor-made structures to support accessories and utilities. Suitable design and fabrication optimise space, simplify installation and maintenance access, meet ergonomic and aesthetic requirements, and increase productivity. We provide matching solutions for your needs.

fabrication.html:
General Fabrication

Fabrication is a general activity done by many at varying levels of quality. We specialise in high-load gratings, storage tanks, and stairs, providing suitable accuracy and quality for trouble-free operations.
